U1.name: multi-commit-no-declaration
U1.certifiable_if: the artefact was modified in more than one commit and names no tree; a declared identity commit, or a single-commit history, would make it certifiable

U2.name: candidate-name-only
U2.certifiable_if: the artefact names a candidate version, not a tree; a commit field, or a tracked mapping from the candidate name to the tree measured, would make it certifiable

U3.name: declared-identity-unresolvable
U3.certifiable_if: the declared commit does not resolve to an ancestor of this tree; a resolving commit would make it certifiable

U4.name: ambiguous-own-identity
U4.certifiable_if: the artefact declares more than one tree and does not certify them equivalent; one tree, or a check that they are source-equivalent, would make it certifiable

U5.name: uncheckable-source-binding
U5.certifiable_if: the source-root digest has no recorded rule and the freeze record it names cannot be read from the tree; a non-null hash rule and a tracked, digest-matching freeze record would make it certifiable

U6.name: build-output-no-identity
U6.certifiable_if: a build output names no source tree; a build-identity record naming the source commit and the output digest would make it certifiable

U7.name: self-qualified-declaration
